facts.claim: The scheme proposed by Mr. Devereux was sanctioned by the Governor General in Council in 1857.
facts.quote: In 1857 the scheme proposed by the Hon. Mr. Devereux, Judicial Commissioner, embracing the requirements of both Mysore and Coorg, received the sanction of the Governor General in Council

facts.claim: Coorg was considered thinly populated with inhabitants living in separate houses scattered among jungles and hills.
facts.quote: Viewing Coorg as a thinly populated country, and one more- over the inhabitants of which lived chiefly in separate houses scattered among jungles and hills

facts.claim: Mr. Devereux proposed establishing a school in each of the six taluks of Coorg.
facts.quote: he proposed that a school should be established in each of the six taluks, on the same footing as the similar class of schools provided for Mysore
